notes: Encoded ONLY from Incremental's own page (an AAF-McQuay group page; no other brand's page imported). Only page Style 1 ships. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 2 (year = single 2nd character, month = 3rd character letter, both chart-only; single-digit year policy bars it with no text table) and page Style 3 (year = 2nd-character letter, month = 3rd-character letter, both chart-only).

styles.notes: Page: year = 5th & 6th characters combined, week = 7th & 8th characters combined (1-based, character counting) -> normalized [4,6] = '08' -> 2008, [6,8] = '05' -> week 5. Example as printed on the page (AUB U 08 05 00386, spaces stripped by normalization).
